title: Understanding Star Schemas
text: Star schemas are a type of database schema that organizes data into fact tables and dimension tables. This structure helps in reducing data redundancy.

title: Data Duplication and Update Errors
text: Data duplication can lead to update errors because if the same data is stored in multiple places, updating one instance but not the others can cause inconsistencies.

title: How Star Schemas Reduce Duplication
text: Star schemas reduce duplication by centralizing data in a single fact table, with related data stored in dimension tables. This minimizes the need to store the same data in multiple places.
